data.title: Electricity price increase from 1 November 2026
data.summary: Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH announces higher prices for the MusterStrom Flex tariff from 1 November 2026. Yearly cost rises from €577.08 to €647.28 and the monthly advance payment from €48.00 to €54.00 from 15 November 2026.
data.explanation: Your electricity provider is raising the price per kWh and the monthly base fee. Your yearly cost rises by €70.20 and your monthly advance payment (Abschlag) goes up to €54.00. You have a special right to cancel (Sonderkündigungsrecht) without a notice period, and the cancellation must reach the provider before the price change takes effect. You can decide whether to accept the new prices or cancel or switch provider; the app shows until when you can cancel. Cancelling is free, and you can do it via the customer portal button.
